title: 第15章 超度你第16章 三彩异火蟒
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
李元没有贸然冲回残蛊楼内，而是控制蛊楼里的蛊虫开始围攻那条小蛇。
“嘶——”
小蛇吐着信子，神态凶狠，竟有几分人性化。
李元一怔。
难道这条小蛇是佘无立身体的一部分？
“那就更要灭口了！”
李元心头一狠，但小蛇无比灵活，一口一只小蛊虫，完全是小型蛊虫的克星。
几经试探后，李元发现小蛇的实力并不强。
决定亲自上阵。
有回生蛊护体，他最不怕这些小东西。
……
与此同时，洞主府内，被皇甫南秘术所制的佘无立懵了。
他被皇甫南算计，才落了下乘。
知晓不敌后，他让重伤的本命蛊从身体中脱离了出去。
他早就将自已和飞蛇蛊炼成一体，即使本体死亡，还能借助飞蛇蛊再次新生。
只要吞食足够的补品就好。
残蛊楼里的蛊虫，还有那个气血充盈的小子，以及拥有珍蛊的小姑娘，都是上好的补品。
若非怕皇甫南针对，他早就吃干抹净。
现在彻底暴露了，他再无顾忌，
“嗯？”

很快佘无立就察觉到不对劲。
“残蛊楼里怎么那么多完整的蛊虫，还一起来围攻我？有人在暗中控制？”
想要以念御蛊，至少也是和他一样的层次了，杀死现在的他易如反掌，没必要如此大费周章。
“到底什么情况？”
正当他百思不得其解时，一道人影从外面冲了进来。
“是那个气血旺盛的小子？”
佘无立一喜。
视线中，那小子步伐飞快，像是急着投胎，直直朝着他冲来。
“吃了他，再吃掉那个拥有珍蛊的小姑娘，我能恢复不少，凝聚出身体来！”
“说不定还有机会杀个回马枪，宰了重伤的皇甫南。”
佘无立越想越兴奋。
待李元冲到近前时，猛地喷射出一滴毒液。
“成功了！”
这可是他的本命毒，只要沾上一滴，五转以下的蛊师立即就会失去气力，任人宰割。
嗖——！
飞蛇倏地扑了出去，血口獠牙，狠狠咬向李元的脖颈处。
“抓到你了。”
一只大手精准抓住了飞蛇七寸，另一只手死死按住其脑袋。
佘无立：“？？？”
我毒液呢？

怎么不起作用？
content_en:
Li Yuan did not rush back into the Gu Tower, but controlled the Gu insects in the Gu Tower to start besieging the little snake.
"Hiss——"
The little snake spit out the letter, with a ferocious expression, and it was actually a bit humane.
Li Yuan was startled.
Could this little snake be part of She Wuli's body?
“Then it’s even more important to silence them!”
Li Yuan's heart was cruel, but the little snake was extremely nimble and could take a small Gu worm in one mouthful. It was completely the nemesis of small Gu worms.
After several trials, Li Yuan discovered that the little snake was not very strong.
Decided to go into battle personally.
With the Resurrection Gu protecting his body, he is least afraid of these little things.
…
At the same time, in the cave master's mansion, She Wuli was stunned by Huangfu Nan's secret technique.
He was tricked by Huangfu Nan and fell into the lower ranks.
After knowing that he was defeated, he let the seriously injured natal Gu escape from his body.
He had already integrated himself with the Flying Snake Gu, and even if his body died, he could still be reborn with the help of the Flying Snake Gu.
Just swallow enough supplements.
The Gu insects in the residual Gu building, the boy with full energy and blood, and the little girl with the precious Gu are all excellent supplements.
If he hadn't been afraid of Huangfu Nan's attack, he would have eaten it all.
Now that he was completely exposed, he no longer had any scruples;
"Huh?"
She Wuli soon realized something was wrong.
"Why are there so many complete Gu insects in the Broken Gu Tower, and they all come together to besiege me? Someone is secretly controlling them?"
If you want to use mind to control Gu, you are at least at the same level as him. Killing him now is easy, there is no need to spend so much effort.
"What's going on?"
Just when he was puzzled, a figure rushed in from outside.
"Is that the energetic boy?"
She Wuli was overjoyed.
In his sight, the boy was walking very fast, as if he was in a hurry to reincarnate, rushing straight towards him.
"After eating him, and then eating the little girl with the precious Gu, I can recover a lot and condense my body!"
"Maybe there's still a chance to come back and kill the seriously injured Huangfunan."
The more She Wuli thought about it, the more excited she became.
When Li Yuan rushed forward, he suddenly sprayed out a drop of venom.
"Success!"
This is his natal poison. As long as it gets a drop of it, Gu masters below rank five will immediately lose their strength and be slaughtered by others.
Whoosh!
The flying snake pounced out quickly, its bloody fangs biting Li Yuan's neck hard.
"Got you."
One big hand accurately grasped the flying snake by seven inches, while the other hand firmly held its head.
She Wuli: "???"
Where is my venom?
Why doesn't it work?
